dek: Smart Analytics Global reports 1.91 million global humanoid robot shipments in H1 2026, up 274 percent year-on-year. Chinese vendors captured 97 percent of the total, with AgiBot at 44 percent and Unitree at 30.9 percent. The US restriction on Chinese robots landed in late July.
